about_the_game:
Waldzweisamkeit is a riddle game with mild horror elements. The player is trapped in an endless forest and needs to find a way out by solving logic based riddles that grow in complexity.

Gameplay

The gameplay of Waldzweisamkeit revolves around investigating the abandoned manor for certain objects that are distributed in the rooms. Then the player needs to choose the room that obeys all rules that are introduced each round. When the wrong room is chosen, the player will be reset and does not progress with the game, so no new rule is introduced. With every run the rooms dynamically shuffle so that the correct room in the next run might be another one. So the only way to proceed is to really understand the rules and the logic behind. 

Playtime

30-60 min

Features

  • Procedually generated endless forest

  • Horror effects (no intended jumpscares)

  • Logic based riddles

Options

  • Language support: English, German

  • Graphics settings: window mode, resolution, V-Sync, FSR, adjustable brightness, anti-aliasing

  • Controller support (except menu)

  • Mouse and controller sensitivity adjustments

Requirements

  • Sound needs to be enabled

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: intel Core i7 4770
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970

short_description: Trapped in an endless forest, the only way to ever leave again, is to follow the mysterious rules in an abandoned manor and finding the correct room. But be aware, you are not alone.
